maps.name: Void Siege
maps.description: Four long parallel lanes, fortified bases with factories, generators and labs. The main map.

maps.name: Lead Reservoir
maps.description: Skirmish for up to 8 players. Islands of a flooded Soviet reservoir in late autumn with the first snow; dams link the home islands, guarded islets and a ruined settlement in the middle.

maps.name: Dead Kombinat
maps.description: Skirmish for up to 6 players. Winter: a frozen river splits a dead industrial town; three bridges, the fenced plant on the north bank and a ruined panel district on the south bank hold the richest points.

maps.name: Random Map
maps.description: A new skirmish map from a random seed: islands, lakes or a river, winter or late autumn, 8 bases, guarded points and a ruined centre. Everyone generates the same map from the seed.

maps.name: Voronezh: Shilovo
maps.description: Winter. The panel blocks of Shilovo on the southern edge of Voronezh; the Void portal opened on the ruins of the unfinished nuclear heating plant. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

maps.name: Proving Grounds
maps.description: A small compact map for quick matches and testing.

maps.name: Void Arena
maps.description: A closed arena with four gates. Build walls, towers and factories around the core.

modes.name: Defense
modes.description: Hold the core through every wave, then destroy the Void portal.

modes.name: Endless
modes.description: Waves never stop and grow stronger every cycle. Survive as long as you can.

modes.name: Arena
modes.description: Waves break through four gates. Build walls, turrets, generators and factories that produce units automatically.

modes.name: Skirmish
modes.description: Players (and AI) build bases, research and fight each other. The last team standing wins. Leave every player on the same lobby team for free-for-all.
